observations.behavior: Changes scheduled task execution time and adds jitter to prevent thundering herd.
observations.posthog_connection: Changes the execution time of the periodic task 'stop surveys that reached responses limits' from every hour at minute 0 to every hour at minute 37. This could help avoid simultaneous execution of many scheduled tasks at the same second, potentially reducing database or worker contention.

observations.behavior: Adds deterministic offset and jitter to schedule specifications.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a 10-minute random jitter and a 2-minute deterministic offset to the business knowledge refresh schedule. This could help distribute the execution of scheduled tasks across the hour, reducing the chance of simultaneous execution and potential resource contention.
